inputs.label: First legal action index of the selected native three-turn completed plan at the first sampled position for each map and seat

training.trainable: All parameters of existing routed-v6 UniversalPolicy
training.objective: Mean searched-action negative log probability on repeatedly presented, unchanged fit snapshots; no KL, augmentation, new roll-ins or terminal reward
training.optimizer: AdamW lr0.0003 weight_decay0, batch16, gradient norm clip1, deterministic shuffle seed6451000, exactly1024 updates

predeclared_gate: At least95% same-snapshot accuracy separately in both seats at update1024: passed, 128/128 in each seat; already reached at update128.

raw.metadata_correction: The raw run's maps=256 field counts snapshots, not independent maps. After the run, code labels these as snapshots=256 and independent_maps=128; numerical readouts and raw file are unchanged.

interpretation: The full network can memorize searched first actions on these 256 repeatedly presented FIT-ONLY states in both seats. This closes the earlier seat0-only capacity limitation. It does not establish unseen-map generalization, autonomous teacher fidelity, whole-turn choices or game strength. The prior rejected Markov student used fresh policy-rollin states, a different learning rate and source KL, so this result does not identify the cause of its failed held-out gate. No neural agent was promoted, rated or deployed.
